purpose: Current canonical map. privateFile/privateSha256 name the exact private source-epoch file and bytes. canonicalSha256 is the file in this directory. rawOriginal names exact source bytes here when a view was formatted or edited. Briefs, histories, wall-clock logs, driver output, validator code and *.original.* files are exact copies. This map excludes itself and sha256.json, so there is no hash cycle; sha256.json indexes every other file including this map. Older private maps, hash indexes and manifests are inert snapshots.
